scope: Four three-poll sequences carry all RAM, CPU/FPU and actual MACL results while external controller payloads change. Independent button change masks, trigger hysteresis, signed axes and four processed primary slots are checked. The updater makes no device/clock/VRAM events and does not alter GBR/MACH/inactive integer banks; the reinitialized empty bus therefore has identical state. This is not a general persistent device scheduler.
limitations: Driver-layout RAM snapshots and valid initialized tables remain explicit fixtures. Hardware controller transport and natural startup are unproved.
